newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices ease, basis steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices ease, basis steady.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent diesel fuel prices eased on falling NYMEX heating oil futures and steady spot differentials on Tuesday, traders said.
Trade was thin as players returned from the three-day holiday weekend, but buying interest was expected to continue supporting diesel and unleaded basis through the week, traders said.
"Basis should remain strong through the March expiry. After that, distillate should be steady but gasoline could go lower," one Group Three trader said.
Jet/kero basis was expected to remain steady this week after making a steady climb in the weeks ahead of last Friday's strike deadline faced by American Airlines and its pilots union.
President Bill Clinton over the weekend imposed a 60-day cooling off period that averted a shutdown of the airline, which operates one of its three hubs in Chicago.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was talked 4.50/4.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX March heating oil for all February timings, with high sulphur steady at 2.50/2.75 cents over the print, traders said.
Group Three unleaded remained 2.50/2.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX March unleaded, with premium talked 2.75 cents higher.
